theme.description: Nordic minimalist editorial design emphasizing content, whitespace, and a writer-first intimate feel. Avoids generic SaaS aesthetics.

body_editor.usage: The actual writing area, generated text, user text inputs.

ui_labels.classes: font-sans tracking-wide uppercase text-xs sm:text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400

layouts.general: Whitespace-heavy, bento grid for dashboards (asymmetric). Focus on optical alignment. Editor should be distraction-free (center column max-width 65ch for reading comfort).
layouts.dashboard_grid: Mode B (High Density) with generous gap-6. Voice analysis widgets use col-span-1 or col-span-2 based on data complexity.
layouts.spacing: Use Tailwind scale p-6, p-8, p-12 heavily. Avoid cramped p-2/p-4 unless inside small UI controls.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid, low contrast (e.g. border-border/40). Thin, elegant lines separating content rather than full-box cards.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Prefer flat design with subtle inner borders for depth rather than drop-shadows.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain noise overlay on backgrounds to simulate paper/physical space.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-sm or rounded-none to maintain editorial/print feel.

components.buttons: Flat, sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-sm). Accent color for primary. Transparent with thin border for secondary.
components.inputs: Understated. Bottom border only (flair) or very subtle fill (bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800). No heavy focus rings, just color change.
components.cards: Cardless or minimal cards. Use grid dividers (border-b, border-r) instead of separate boxes.
components.toasts: Use `sonner`. Position bottom-center, minimal style matching Nordic theme.

motion.transitions: Subtle opacity and slight y-axis translation (e.g. 2px). Duration 300ms ease-out.
motion.hover: Text color darkens/lightens. Buttons subtle scale down (0.98).
motion.page_load: Fade in with stagger on grid items.

auth.description: Google OAuth and JWT Email/Password. Minimalist split screen with atmospheric Nordic image on one side.

file_upload.description: Drag & drop zone with dashed border. Supports .txt, .pdf, .docx. Includes text area for manual paste.

voice_analysis.description: Dashboard showing tone, vocabulary complexity, and sentence structure. Use Recharts with minimalist styling (no grid lines, simple tooltips, accent colors).

writer_assistant.description: Editor view. 'Continue my text' button. Dropdown for LLM selection (Claude Sonnet 4.5, GPT 5.2, Gemini 3 Pro). Panel for generated output with 'Regenerate', 'Copy', and 'Humanize more' controls.

ai_detection_avoidance.description: Toggle or score meter showing 'Human-like' vs 'AI-like'. Built into the writer assistant output panel.

language.instruction: All UI text, placeholders, and tooltips MUST be in Norwegian. Example: 'Logg inn', 'Last opp dokument', 'Fortsett teksten', 'Min stemme'.

image_urls.description: Atmospheric Nordic forest mist for the login/signup split screen.
Minimalist open notebook for empty states or placeholder content.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA compliant contrast. Minimalist text MUST be readable, avoid overly light gray text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes formatted as role-based kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly use Norwegian language across all UI elements.
DO NOT use generic Shadcn Card layouts. Use border-collapse and subtle dividers to create an editorial grid feel.
Use Lora for the actual text editor/writing areas to mimic a literary environment, and Cormorant Garamond for main headers.
Ensure LLM selection (Claude Sonnet 4.5, GPT 5.2, Gemini 3 Pro) is prominently available in the writing view via custom select/dropdown.
Implement the 'Humanize more' (Gjør mer menneskelig) and AI-detection avoidance features in the generation panel.
Use standard HTML inputs customized via Tailwind for complex form states, avoiding deep component abstraction if it hinders editorial styling.
Add data-testid to all buttons, inputs, toggles, and main semantic sections.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or fixed headers.
Avoid the generic 'AI slop' aesthetic (no emojis). Use refined SVG icons (lucide-react).
Never use `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition-colors` or `transition-opacity`.
Files are .js, not .tsx. Do not output TypeScript interfaces.
